```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release-cut:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install googleapis-common-protos

      - name: Run Release: Cut
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/candidate
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore(release): cut release candidate"
          git push origin release/candidate

  release-please:
    needs: release-cut
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install googleapis-common-protos

      - name: Run Release: Please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: library
          path: .
          target-branch: release/candidate
          config-file: .github/release-please-config.json
          manifest-file: pyproject.toml
          repo-url: https://github.com/google/adk-python-community.git
          skip-github-release: true

  release-finalize:
    needs: [release-cut, release-please]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install googleapis-common-protos

      - name: Get release version
        id: get_release_version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)"

      - name: Run Release: Finalize
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v${{ steps.get_release_version.outputs.version }}
          git cherry-pick $(git log --pretty=format:"%H" release/candidate..main)
          git push origin release/v${{ steps.get_release_version.outputs.version }}

  create-release:
    needs: release-finalize
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install googleapis-common-protos

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.get_release_version.outputs.version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ steps.get_release_version.outputs.version }}
          body: |
            This is a new release of the ADK Python Community project.
            For more information, please see the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/google/adk-python-community/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

  release-publish:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install googleapis-common-protos setuptools wheel twine

      - name: Build package
        run: |
          python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        run: |
          twine upload dist/*
```
